correctness.rationale: For fixed Boolean environment, independent walk increments make X_N,Y_N martingales; only synchronous increments contribute to covariance. Thus C_N=1+sum_{j=1}^{N-1} U_j with independent centered uniform-map layer averages Var(U_j)=2^{-j}; sum converges a.s./L² and tail variance 2^{1-N}. Product characteristic function prod_j cos(t/2^j)^{2^j} is exact; cumulant addition yields Var=1,kappa4=-2/7,E Z^4=19/7 (non-Gaussian). Dyadic finite residue law follows since every nontrivial Fourier character mod 2 has one vanishing cosine factor; independent integer-convolution checks confirmed exact uniform residue distributions at levels L=1 through 6. At infinite level all integer nonzero Fourier coefficients vanish. One factor at j=ceil(log2|t|) bounds characteristic decay by exp(-c|t|), giving analytic density; fixed-point law by level splitting and uniqueness by centered W2 contraction factor 1/sqrt2. All infinite claims follow from these arguments, not finite tests.
